The plan is safe. It sticks to the physio's clearance: three walk-run days only, with rest or non-running days in between. The step up is small, from 10 to 12 minutes of total running, so the return isn't rushed and no must-never check is triggered. Every day can be run as written: rounds, durations, a talking pace and a heart-rate cap on Saturday. The rest days come before and after the longest session, with a shin check on Monday.

Two things cost it a point. First, it states facts the card doesn't support. The card says "Shin quiet", not "pain at 0 out of 10 on every run", and it never mentions a "physio's calf and hip routine". Second, the visible text doesn't clearly repeat the physio's rule to stop if the shin aches, and it doesn't speak to Ines feeling nervous.
